Current upstream Omarchy scripts and palettes, retrieved 2026-10-18 from
https://github.com/omacom/omarchy (master; former basecamp/omarchy URLs redirect).

- bin/omarchy-launch-editor
- bin/omarchy-theme-color
- bin/omarchy-tui-install
- themes/tokyo-night/colors.toml
- themes/catppuccin-latte/colors.toml

Files retain the upstream MIT license in LICENSE. Tests execute these scripts
inside isolated homes with stubbed platform commands. They are compatibility
fixtures, not evidence of a native Omarchy session. SHA256SUMS identifies the
exact bytes used even if upstream master changes.
